Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
227 AM EDT Sun Oct 11 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH THIS EVENING...

.OVERNIGHT...E winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 2 to
3 ft. Showers.
.SUN...E winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. Showers
with a chance of tstms. 
.SUN NIGHT...SE winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming SW late. Gusts up to
20 kt. Waves 3 ft...subsiding to 1 ft after midnight. Showers likely
with a chance of tstms. 
.MON...N winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 25 kt. Waves 2 ft. Showers.
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TUE...SW winds 5 kt...becoming S 10 to 15 kt in the afternoon.
Waves flat...building to 2 ft in the afternoon. 
.TUE NIGHT...SW winds 10 to 15 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.WED...NW winds 5 to 10 kt...becoming N 10 to 15 kt after midnight.
Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.THU...N winds 10 to 15 kt...becoming E 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 to 2 ft.
A chance of showers after midnight.  

Winds and waves higher and visibilities lower in and near tstms.
